purpose: R4-M1H scope and oracle identity. The accepted pmm.c at main 36368bc8 (tree 4f6b46db) is identified by its hash; the R4-M1H change must be exactly one bounded low-memory clear in pmm_init_in (scripts/test-pmm-init.py reconstructs the accepted file from the production one and checks this hash). The vulnerable frozen oracle is the existing tests/reference/pmm-r4m1.c, whose helpers and pmm_init_in (the first 3,825 bytes, up to pmm_alloc_in) are byte-identical to the accepted main's. Not linked into the kernel.
